module_summary: Differential source-synchronous SDR output: an SDR output register stage produces forwarded clock and data, which are driven out through differential buffers (or true/complement assigns generically).

anchors.name: input_d
anchors.why: Parallel data registered by the SDR output stage.

anchors.name: output_q
anchors.why: Registered single-ended data feeding the differential output buffers.

anchors.name: output_clk
anchors.why: Forwarded source-synchronous clock from SDR stage, driven differentially.

anchors.name: output_q_p
anchors.why: Positive leg of differential data output.

anchors.name: output_q_n
anchors.why: Negative leg of differential data output.

anchors.name: output_clk_p
anchors.why: Positive leg of forwarded differential clock.

anchors.name: output_clk_n
anchors.why: Negative leg of forwarded differential clock.

groups.name: SDR output register
groups.description: Registers data and generates the forwarded output clock.

groups.name: Differential output buffers
groups.description: Drives clock and data as true/complement differential pairs.
